newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press Digest - France - Le Monde April 9.
newsitem.headline: Press Digest - France - Le Monde April 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Teachers' unions endorse reform project of university studies presented by education minister Francois Bayrou.
-- The strength of the franc may allow room for rate cuts by the Bank of France, whose Monetary Policy Council meets tomorrow.
-- Unions at air transport group TAT-Air Liberte to strike today to protest details of planned merger of the two companies.
-- Labour Minister Jacques Barrot to present bill reforming law on working hours, notably to bring it in line with European directives.
-- Cabinet meeting to endorse today new decree introducing flexibility of working hours and opening days in the banking sector.
